description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface, including methods for formatting and appending log messages, and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, with methods for formatting, displaying, and chaining log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and outputs it to the LogView, also passing it to the next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
